title: Будущее: will, be going to, Present Continuous для планов

why: В русском будущее почти всегда одно: «буду делать». В английском три основных способа, и каждый говорит о своём: решение «прямо сейчас», заранее задуманный план и договорённость на конкретное время.
formation: • will + глагол без to. I will call you. Отрицание: will not = won't. Вопрос: Will you come?
• am/is/are + going to + глагол. She is going to study. Отрицание: I'm not going to go. Вопрос: Are they going to move?
• Present Continuous: am/is/are + глагол-ing. We are meeting the client at 3. Вопрос: Is he meeting his boss?
usage: 1. will: решение в момент речи. The phone is ringing. — I'll answer it. (Звонит телефон. — Я отвечу.)
2. will: обещание, предложение помощи. I won't tell anyone. (Я никому не скажу.) Don't worry, I'll help you. (Не волнуйся, я помогу.)
3. will: прогноз и мнение (I think, probably, perhaps). I think it will rain tomorrow. (Думаю, завтра будет дождь.)
4. be going to: план или намерение, решённое заранее. I'm going to learn German this year. (Я собираюсь выучить немецкий в этом году.)
5. be going to: прогноз по явным признакам, которые видны сейчас. Look at those clouds! It's going to rain. (Смотри на тучи! Сейчас будет дождь.)
6. Present Continuous: договорённость, о которой уже есть время и место. I'm meeting Anna at six tomorrow. (Я встречаюсь с Анной завтра в шесть.)
signalWords: tomorrow, tonight, next week, soon, later, in two days; I think, probably, perhaps (чаще с will); Look! (чаще с going to).
mistakes: ✗ I will to call you. → ✓ I will call you. После will нет to.
✗ She will goes there. → ✓ She will go there. После will глагол остаётся в начальной форме.
✗ We going to buy a car. → ✓ We are going to buy a car. Без am/is/are going to не работает.
✗ A: I forgot my wallet. B: I'm going to pay. → ✓ I'll pay. Решение принято сейчас, значит will.
✗ Look at the sky! It will rain. → ✓ It's going to rain. Есть признаки, значит going to.
✗ I'm not going go. → ✓ I'm not going to go. Между going и глаголом обязательно to.
remember: Решил сейчас: will. Уже решил: going to. Договорился на время: Present Continuous.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте will или won't с глаголом в скобках

items.prompt: I'm cold. I ___ (close) the window.
items.answer: will close / 'll close

items.prompt: Don't worry. I ___ (not tell) anyone.
items.answer: won't tell / will not tell

items.prompt: I think it ___ (rain) tomorrow.
items.answer: will rain

items.prompt: The phone is ringing. I ___ (answer) it.
items.answer: will answer / 'll answer

items.prompt: She probably ___ (be) late.
items.answer: will be / 'll be

items.prompt: I promise I ___ (not forget) your birthday.
items.answer: won't forget / will not forget

items.prompt: Don't carry that box. I ___ (help) you.
items.answer: will help / 'll help

items.prompt: Perhaps he ___ (call) you later.
items.answer: will call / 'll call

exercises.instruction: Выберите will, be going to или Present Continuous

items.prompt: Look at those clouds! It (a) will rain (b) is going to rain.
items.answer: (b) is going to rain

items.prompt: I've decided: I (a) will learn (b) am going to learn German this year.
items.answer: (b) am going to learn

items.prompt: A: We have no milk. B: Oh, I (a) will buy (b) am going to buy some.
items.answer: (a) will buy

items.prompt: I've bought the tickets. We (a) will fly (b) are flying to Berlin on Friday.
items.answer: (b) are flying

items.prompt: I think people (a) will travel (b) are travelling to Mars in the future.
items.answer: (a) will travel

items.prompt: Careful! You (a) will fall (b) are going to fall!
items.answer: (b) are going to fall

items.prompt: He has just bought paint. He (a) will paint (b) is going to paint the room.
items.answer: (b) is going to paint

items.prompt: A: I'm so tired. B: Go to bed. I (a) will wash (b) am going to wash the dishes.
items.answer: (a) will wash

exercises.instruction: Сделайте отрицание или вопрос по заданию

items.prompt: She will call you tomorrow. (negative)
items.answer: She won't call you tomorrow. / She will not call you tomorrow.

items.prompt: They are going to move to Lviv. (question)
items.answer: Are they going to move to Lviv?

items.prompt: You will come to the party. (question)
items.answer: Will you come to the party?

items.prompt: I'm going to buy a car. (negative)
items.answer: I'm not going to buy a car. / I am not going to buy a car.

items.prompt: He is meeting his manager today. (question)
items.answer: Is he meeting his manager today?

items.prompt: We will be late. (negative)
items.answer: We won't be late. / We will not be late.

items.prompt: She is going to study medicine. (question with What)
items.answer: What is she going to study?

items.prompt: The team is going to release the update on Monday. (question with When)
items.answer: When is the team going to release the update?

items.prompt: I will to call you later.
items.answer: I will call you later.

items.prompt: She will goes to London next week.
items.answer: She will go to London next week.

items.prompt: Look at the sky! It will rain.
items.answer: Look at the sky! It's going to rain. / Look at the sky! It is going to rain.

items.prompt: We going to buy a new house.
items.answer: We are going to buy a new house. / We're going to buy a new house.

items.prompt: A: I forgot my wallet. B: Don't worry, I'm going to pay.
items.answer: A: I forgot my wallet. B: Don't worry, I'll pay. / A: I forgot my wallet. B: Don't worry, I will pay.

items.prompt: Will she comes to the meeting?
items.answer: Will she come to the meeting?

items.prompt: I'm not going go to the party.
items.answer: I'm not going to go to the party. / I am not going to go to the party.

items.prompt: We are meet the client tomorrow at 10.
items.answer: We are meeting the client tomorrow at 10. / We're meeting the client tomorrow at 10.

items.prompt: Я позвоню тебе вечером.
items.answer: I'll call you tonight. / I will call you tonight. / I'll call you this evening. / I will call you this evening.

items.prompt: Завтра я встречаюсь с клиентом в десять.
items.answer: I'm meeting a client at ten tomorrow. / I'm meeting the client at ten tomorrow. / I'm meeting a client tomorrow at ten.

items.prompt: Мы собираемся переехать в новый офис.
items.answer: We are going to move to a new office. / We're going to move to a new office.

items.prompt: Смотри, сейчас пойдёт дождь.
items.answer: Look, it's going to rain. / Look, it is going to rain.

items.prompt: Я думаю, завтра будет жарко.
items.answer: I think it will be hot tomorrow.

items.prompt: Не волнуйся, я тебе помогу.
items.answer: Don't worry, I'll help you. / Don't worry, I will help you.

items.prompt: Что ты собираешься делать в выходные?
items.answer: What are you going to do at the weekend? / What are you going to do this weekend? / What are you going to do on the weekend?

items.prompt: Она не придёт на встречу.
items.answer: She won't come to the meeting. / She isn't coming to the meeting. / She is not going to come to the meeting.
